scene: The bronze key sparks, unlocking three bustling transit gates along the park.
picture: A flat side view along a wet cobblestone ground line. On the far left, a tiled subway entrance glows beneath neon signs. In the centre sits a yellow street tram with open doors. The player in yellow raincoat stands mid-right holding a glowing bronze key. On the far right waits an indigo night bus.
shown: a glowing tiled subway stairwell on the far left with open turnstiles
a bright yellow street tram idling in the centre with open doors
